title: Electric Vehicle Raffle Is Insanely UNDERSOLD. 4,500 Tickets Remain With Less Than 21 Days Before Drawing. Stunning Odds for You. Tickets Benefit Nonprofit.
text:
### 还剩4500张未售出，中奖概率极高

一个电动车的抽奖活动，距离7月30日开奖不到21天，居然还有超过4500张门票没卖出去。对于想赢一辆车的人来说，这简直是天上掉馅饼。

总票数上限是10000张，现在只卖了一半多。这意味着，你花200美元买一张票，中奖概率比正常抽奖高出一大截。而且每张票可以参加三次抽奖（三个不同奖项），不是一次。

### 奖品清单：从Rivian到Porsche

头奖得主可以在七款顶级电动车里任选一辆：

- **Rivian R1S SUV 或 R1T 皮卡**：冒险取向，适合露营和越野
- **Lucid Air 或 Lucid Gravity**：续航冠军，芝加哥到纳什维尔一箱电
- **Porsche Macan、Taycan 或 Cayenne 电动版**：速度与豪华兼备

二等奖得主可以选：

- **大众 ID. Buzz**：复古风格的面包车，适合家庭和露营
- **现代 Ioniq 系列**：多次获得世界汽车大奖
- **Rivian R2**：备受期待的中型SUV

三等奖得主拿到的是全新改款的 **雪佛兰 Bolt RS**，续航262英里，配置齐全。

所有获奖者不需要自己交税——**州和联邦的奖品税都由主办方承担**。这是很少见的福利。

### 200美元三连抽，还支持环保

每张门票200美元，收入全部捐给 **CCAN Action Fund**，一个在国会和州议会推动清洁能源和清洁交通的非营利组织。美国交通领域贡献了约30%的气候污染物，他们的目标之一就是让更多人开上电动车。

去年的头奖得主Tom D.（来自北卡罗来纳州）选了Rivian R1S，他说“每次开出去都觉得兴奋，性能无可比拟”。二等奖得主Justin K.（明尼苏达州）赢了大众ID. Buzz，他说“开电动车更安静、更有力，开出去还总有人冲我微笑招手”。

### 截止日期7月30日，现在买最值

开奖时间：**7月30日美东时间下午6点截止销售，7点公布结果**。你只需要年满18岁，居住在美国，就可以参与。

还剩4500张未售出意味着：你的中奖概率远高于大多数慈善抽奖。与其买彩票碰运气，不如花200美元赌一把，赢的是一辆价值数万甚至十万美元的电动车，而且还能帮环保组织做事。

**行动结论**：如果你对美国市场感兴趣，或者正好打算换辆电动车，现在去CCAN Action Fund的官网买张票，性价比极高。概率好，税不用你出，奖品还是顶级品牌。7月30日就开奖，别等。
prompt_system:
你是中文科技与产业内容编辑。擅长把信息密度高的英文报告、外电、机器翻译稿或资讯稿，改写成逻辑清晰、读感流畅的中文文章。

目标读者是有一定专业背景的从业者，时间有限，不喜欢废话。

语言风格：
- 口语化，对话感强，像和读者面对面聊天
- 短段落，多留白，视觉舒适
- 善用生活化类比解释复杂概念
- 始终使用第三人称视角叙述
- 不要用第一人称自称，不要把原文里的 I / we / you 机械直译成作者对读者喊话
- 真诚、不装，专业但不掉书袋
- 数据和案例支撑观点

格式规范：
- 重要观点用 **加粗** 突出
- 全程使用中文标点
- 禁止使用中文破折号和英文破折号
- 禁止使用水平分隔线
- 不输出一级标题，直接从开头钩子进入正文，小标题使用二级或三级标题
- 只输出改写后的中文 Markdown 文章，不要解释过程，不要输出自查清单

禁用表达：
- 禁用句式：不是……而是、想象一下、你有没有想过、值得注意的是、不难理解、毋庸置疑、随着……的发展、对于……来说、在……方面
- 禁用词汇：精准打击、赋能、落地、深度融合、全面布局、强势崛起等空洞套话
- 英文 newslet

Stunning Odds for You. Tickets Benefit Nonprofit. July 10, 2026 30 minutes Industry Sponsor 0 Comments Support CleanTechnica's work through a Substack subscription or on Stripe . In less than three weeks, a clean energy nonprofit will give away three amazing electric cars. But here’s the problem for the charity: Over 4,500 tickets are still unsold. But that’s a PLUS for you. With fewer tickets sold, your chances of winning a Rivian or Lucid or Porsche EV are AMAZING. And you help a great cause. Get your ticket today! This is the eighth year in a row that the clean energy group, CCAN Action Fund, has raffled an electric vehicle. Each ticket you buy gives you not one, not two, but THREE chances to win. And the drawing is almost here: July 30. CLICK HERE: UNDERSOLD EV RAFFLE WITH STUNNING PRIZES! DRAWING JULY 30 FOR THREE CHANCES TO WIN AN EV. You could be behind the wheel of a stunning new EV by this fall! The first-prize winner will choose between an adventurous Rivian R1S SUV or R1T truck. Or the long-range champion Lucid Air or even the Lucid Gravity. Or, finally, a sporty electric Porsche Macan, Taycan, or Cayenne. The second-prize winner will get to choose between the retro and fun Volkswagen ID. Buzz van, the fan-favorite Hyundai Ioniq family, and the long-awaited Rivian R2. And the third-prize winner will get the keys to a newly relaunched Chevrolet Bolt. Your $200 ticket supports a good cause and earns you three chances to win one of the best electric vehicles on the market, with incredible odds. Even better, state and federal prize taxes are covered! SUPPORT A NONPROFIT FIGHTING FOR CLEAN ENERGY AND TO GET MORE EVS ON THE ROAD. CLICK HERE TO ENTER. Here’s more about the prizes. Ready for adventure? The Rivian truck or SUV might be the electric vehicle for you. The Rivian R1T and R1S both get rave reviews for speed, power, and adventure-ready design. With this EV you can go off-roading or camping with everything you need right inside. Two previous winners of this raffle have chosen the R1T and say it’s everything they hoped for. Or how about a sleek Lucid Air or Gravity? The Air is a long-range champion that can take you from Chicago to Nashville on one charge. With its cutting edge technology, Lucid is quickly becoming a driver favorite. Meanwhile, Porsche needs no introduction. Imagine yourself behind the wheel of an attention-grabbing electric Taycan, Macan, or Cayenne with maximum features for speed and luxury. The first-prize winner will have their pick from these seven extraordinary EVs. The second-prize winner will get to choose between the Volkswagen ID. Buzz—a truly family-friendly vehicle that doubles as an ideal camping companion—the rugged and highly anticipated midsize Rivian R2, or a brand-new car from the Hyundai Ioniq family, a high-tech, high-performance line which has won numerous World Car Awards. And the third-prize winner will receive the newly revamped Chevrolet Bolt RS with all the bells and whistles and a 262-mile range! CLICK HERE TO GET YOUR TICKET TODAY. MORE THAN 4,500 TICKETS UNSOLD. WINNER DRAWN JULY 30. The raffle drawing is almost here! Your $200 ticket could have you driving a new electric car before the end of the year. Anyone can win! Last year’s first-place winner was Tom D. of North Carolina, who won a Rivian R1S. Tom told us he loves how his new electric SUV feels. “The performance and power are unlike anything I’ve ever owned; it’s exciting every time I get behind the wheel.” He’s planning to fill it with “as many adventures as possible. Whether it’s a long road trip, a spontaneous weekend in the mountains of NC, or a relaxing escape to the beach.” Last year’s second-place winner was Justin K. of Minnesota. He won the adorable Volkswagen ID. Buzz and says “driving an EV is just more fun…. Less noise, no exhaust, and WAY more power!” He takes the car on camping trips, and whenever he drives it around, he says he gets a lot of smiles and waves. “People seem to get a real kick out of the unique look of the Buzz.” You could be one of this year’s lucky winners. Your raffle ticket not only gives you THREE chances to win, it makes you a champion for the planet. DRAWING IN LESS THAN THREE WEEKS. GET YOUR TICKET TODAY. With this summer’s wildly volatile gas prices, the raffle and CCAN Action Fund’s clean transportation advocacy work couldn’t be more timely. Every ticket helps CCAN Action Fund advocate for clean energy and clean transportation on Capitol Hill and statehouses. Cars, trucks, and other forms of transportation account for nearly 30 percent of America’s climate pollution. One of CCAN Action Fund’s goals is to get you and everyone else behind the wheel of an electric vehicle. Whether you’re going on an outdoor adventure or cruising city streets, when you sit behind the wheel of an electric vehicle, you’re helping preserve the natural world for generations to come (and avoiding high gas prices forever!). It’s never been clearer — the time to start driving an electric vehicle is NOW. Purchase a ticket today and enjoy the payoff for years (and generations) to come! With 4,500 tickets still unsold out of a maximum of 10,000, your chances of winning are incredible. All raffle proceeds support the CCAN Action Fund team as they advocate for clean energy and transportation. GET YOUR EV RAFFLE TICKET TODAY. DRAWING JULY 30. SUPPORT A NONPROFIT. Raffle will close at 6:00 PM ET on Thursday, July 30, and the winners will be announced at 7:00 PM ET the same day. You must be 18 years old to participate and must purchase the ticket in the United States, must reside in the United States, and must pay taxes in the United States. Vehicle manufacturers are not participants in or sponsors of this raffle. Void where prohibited. See Official Rules HERE .
